wow_catering_family.claim: Are WOW!Catering / WOW Furshet / WOW Events the same company or three different ones?

wow_catering.description: Independent SPb catering company «WOW!CATERING». Mentions clients like «Ростелеком», «hh», «Superjob», «Сбербанк».

wow_furshet.description: Independent SPb catering company «WOW FURSHET». Focuses on фуршет, гастробоксы, детское меню, доставка по СПб и ЛО.

wow_events.description: «WOW Events» SPb. IMPORTANT: Instagram @woweventsspb explicitly states: «WOW Events × Zeppelin Catering — создаем события со вкусом и характером». Brand chef Дмитрий Калюжный is shared with ZEPPELIN Catering (zepcatering.ru). So WOW Events is part of / partner with the ZEPPELIN Events group (zepcatering.ru).

wow_catering_family.overall: All three URLs work and represent three different SPb catering brands. WOW Events is actually part of the ZEPPELIN Catering group (Дмитрий Калюжный brand chef). The HTML card S8 takeaway «Сравните с WOW!CATERING — один бренд, разные подходы» is MISLEADING — they are NOT one brand; they are three different companies.

key_findings_for_html_fix.issue: Concord Catering (S1) URL concord-catering.ru is PARKED at timeweb.ru — does not host the real Concord Catering website anymore. SpeedRent also flags one of their venues as «Площадка закрыта навсегда». The company appears to be defunct or restructured.
key_findings_for_html_fix.fix: Replace the concord-catering.ru URL with an archive link (restoclub.ru/spb/place/concord-catering) OR remove the card and replace with an active SPb caterer. Update the «0 битых ссылок» badge — concord-catering.ru IS effectively broken.

key_findings_for_html_fix.issue: Muscat Catering (M4) — the HTML uses correct URL catering-muscat.ru, BUT the verification list also asks about muscat-catering.ru which DOES NOT EXIST. If the HTML or any future docs reference muscat-catering.ru, replace with catering-muscat.ru.

key_findings_for_html_fix.issue: WOW Events (S8) takeaway text says «Сравните с WOW!CATERING — один бренд, разные подходы». This is INCORRECT — WOW!Catering (wow-catering.ru), WOW Furshet (wowfurshet-spb.ru), and WOW Events (wow-eve.ru) are THREE SEPARATE companies. WOW Events is actually part of the ZEPPELIN Catering group (zepcatering.ru, brand chef Дмитрий Калюжный).
key_findings_for_html_fix.fix: Rewrite the S8 takeaway to: «Сравните с WOW!CATERING и WOW Furshet — три разных SPb-бренда; WOW Events входит в группу ZEPPELIN Catering (бренд-шеф Дмитрий Калюжный).»
